previewNote: Preview: Robert hasn't chosen the partner charities yet. The causes below are examples of the kind of story each month will tell.
pledgeRule: Vilasi gives 5% of Vilasi Pass revenue to the month's cause.

causes.name: Example: Clean water for villages in Nepal
causes.story: In many mountain villages, families walk hours each day for water. A simple gravity-fed system brings clean water to a whole village for years.

impact.what: water filters for a family for a month
a share of a village water tank

causes.volunteer: Ask your church or club to adopt one village project.
causes.prayer: Pray for safe water, health and strength for the families of Nepal.

causes.name: Example: Meals for kids over the holidays
causes.story: When school is out, many children lose the meals they count on. Weekend food bags fill that gap.

impact.what: a weekend of meals for one child

causes.volunteer: Pack food bags at a local food bank.
causes.prayer: Pray that no child goes hungry this winter.
